data.name: Haamidah
data.long_meaning: Haamidah is a beautiful Arabic name for girls that means 'Companion to the Praised One'. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'H-M-D', which means 'to praise'. In Islamic tradition, Haamidah is a name given to a girl who is a devoted companion to the praised one, often referring to Allah or a loved one.
